topic: Analyzing impression discrepancies and traffic growth
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on analyzing discrepancies in reported impressions, particularly for April 9th and April 15th, where zero impressions were noted. It was determined that the traffic increase observed since April 17th was due to the inclusion of 'respect to zero-session predicts' starting from April 17th.

To resolve the impression discrepancy, it was decided to copy data for the periods 9.04 and 15.04–23.04 from the staging environment (stage) into the analysis.

Regarding the overall trend, after confirming the necessary adjustments, the general view of the metrics at a high level appeared acceptable.
decisions: Copy data for April 9th and April 15th-23rd from the stage environment to analyze impression discrepancies.
action_items: Monitor metrics going forward; no further action required on specific date ranges as the issue was resolved.
